description: Dispute over a rejected funding or payment declaration (non-custodial model, RFC-003, architecture v1.2). Opens ONLY from a REJECTED declaration within 30 days; support resolves it reviewing the structured transfer evidence (CEP validation via PaymentProvider). Resolution flips the underlying declaration to CONFIRMED or leaves it CANCELLED — always through the declaration's own SP so paymentHistory (D16) records the transition.

fields.name: loanId
fields.description: Loan the disputed declaration belongs to.

fields.name: openedByClientId
fields.description: Party that opened the dispute (normally the payer whose declaration was rejected).

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Why the party disputes the rejection.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Allowed values: OPEN, RESOLVED_CONFIRMED, RESOLVED_REJECTED, CANCELLED. Defaults to OPEN.

fields.name: resolutionNote
fields.description: Mandatory when support resolves — what was verified and why.

relationships.notes: Multi-tenant isolation via companyId — injected automatically by stored procedures.
Disputes trace back to the loan for the support queue.

components.name: PaymentDisputeListStep
components.description: IonList newest-first by companyId: loanId, subjectType, openedBy, reason excerpt, status chip (OPEN amber / RESOLVED_CONFIRMED green / RESOLVED_REJECTED red / CANCELLED gray).

hints: Status machine: OPEN -> RESOLVED_CONFIRMED | RESOLVED_REJECTED | CANCELLED. Illegal transitions return an error.
Only one OPEN dispute per (subjectType, subjectId) — unique filtered index.
resolve action requires resolutionNote and returns the subject ids so the caller flips the underlying declaration via its own SP (history recorded there).
